tagline.zh: 同一对端色,换个插值空间就是另一条渐变:in srgb/oklab/oklch/display-p3 与四种 hue 策略,治好 sRGB 插值长距离过渡的脏灰带。
tagline.en: One pair of endpoints, a different gradient per interpolation space: in srgb/oklab/oklch/display-p3 plus the four hue strategies — the cure for sRGB's muddy gray band on long transitions.

origin.zh: 插值空间与 hue 策略由 CSS Color 4 §13 定义(调研 06§4);工业落地参照 Tailwind CSS v4(2025-01):调色板整体改用 oklch、渐变默认 OKLAB 插值、可用 /srgb 等修饰符切换(调研 06§4/§六5)。
origin.en: Interpolation spaces and hue strategies are defined by CSS Color 4 §13 (research 06 §4); the industrial reference is Tailwind CSS v4 (2025-01): palette wholesale moved to oklch, gradients default to OKLAB interpolation with /srgb modifiers to switch (research 06 §4/§6-5).

effect.zh: JS 型参数:插值色彩空间。默认 oklab——Tailwind v4 渐变默认即 OKLAB 插值(调研 06§4);CSS Color 4 §13.1 亦规定宿主语法未定义兜底时用 Oklab。不写 in 时旧式 hex/命名色按兼容条款在 gamma sRGB 插值——长距离色相过渡易出脏灰带。oklch 保 chroma 最鲜艳;srgb 是兼容之选;display-p3 在 P3 基色上插值。
effect.en: JS-type param: the interpolation color space. Default oklab — Tailwind v4's gradients default to OKLAB (research 06 §4); CSS Color 4 §13.1 also names Oklab as the fallback when a host syntax defines none. Without `in`, legacy hex/named colors interpolate in gamma sRGB per the compat clause — long hue transitions go muddy. oklch maximizes chroma; srgb is the compatibility pick; display-p3 interpolates on P3 primaries.

effect.zh: JS 型参数:色相插值策略,**仅对柱坐标空间有效**——本条目四个选项中只有 oklch 是柱坐标(srgb/oklab/display-p3 是直角空间,写 hue 关键词整条声明无效)。默认 shorter 取规范缺省:柱坐标空间未指定时按短弧插值(调研 06§4 仅列四策略清单未记载默认值,写作时已抓取 W3C CSS Color 4 §13.1 原文复核确认)。
effect.en: JS-type param: hue interpolation strategy, **valid only for polar spaces** — among this entry's four options only oklch is polar (srgb/oklab/display-p3 are rectangular; a hue keyword there invalidates the whole declaration). Default shorter is the spec default: unspecified hue methods on polar spaces take the short arc (research 06 §4 lists the four strategies without recording the default; re-verified against the W3C CSS Color 4 §13.1 text while writing).

effect.zh: 渐变起点色。默认 #FF0000 = CSS 命名色 red,取自调研/spec 例证 `linear-gradient(in oklab, red, blue)` 的起点(调研 06§4)——红蓝对撞正是展示 sRGB 插值脏灰带的经典用例。
effect.en: Gradient start color. Default #FF0000 = the CSS named color red, the start of the research/spec example `linear-gradient(in oklab, red, blue)` (research 06 §4) — the red-blue clash is the classic showcase of sRGB's muddy midband.

effect.zh: 渐变终点色。默认 #0000FF = CSS 命名色 blue,同上例证。demo 同时以 color-mix(in 空间, from, to) 显示各空间 50% 中点色,脏灰带在 sRGB 的中点上最直观。
effect.en: Gradient end color. Default #0000FF = the CSS named color blue, same example. The demo also shows each space's 50% midpoint via color-mix(in space, from, to) — sRGB's muddy band is most visible right at the midpoint.

note.zh: in 空间渐变语法出自 CSS Color 4 §13(调研 06§六4,一手来源 W3C 规范);调研未逐浏览器记载该语法的支持年份,实施前请以 MDN/Can I Use 复核。底层颜色函数 oklch() 自 2023-05 起全主流支持(调研 06§1);color-mix() 为 CSS Color 5 函数。
note.en: The in-space gradient syntax comes from CSS Color 4 §13 (research 06 §6-4; primary source is the W3C spec); the research does not record per-browser support years for the syntax — re-check MDN/Can I Use before shipping. The underlying oklch() is supported by all mainstream browsers since 2023-05 (research 06 §1); color-mix() is a CSS Color 5 function.

fallback.zh: 不支持 in 语法的浏览器整条声明失效:先写不带 in 的普通渐变兜底,再覆写 in 版本;demo 即采用该结构——样式表里的普通渐变是兜底,内联 in 渐变仅在可解析时生效(无效内联声明被丢弃后自动落回样式表)。
fallback.en: Browsers without the in syntax drop the whole declaration: ship a plain gradient without `in` first, then override with the in-space version. The demo is built exactly that way — the stylesheet's plain gradient is the fallback, and the inline in-gradient only applies when parseable (an invalid inline declaration is discarded, falling back to the stylesheet).

use.zh: 长距离色相过渡(红→蓝、橙→紫):显式 in oklab/in oklch,避免 sRGB 默认插值的中段脏灰(调研 06§4)
use.en: Long hue transitions (red→blue, orange→purple): explicit in oklab/in oklch to dodge sRGB's default muddy midband (research 06 §4)

use.zh: 极坐标空间保鲜艳:in oklch 让 chroma 全程不塌,Tailwind v4 默认渐变即 OKLAB 插值(调研 06§4)
use.en: Keeping vividness across polar spaces: in oklch holds chroma the whole way; Tailwind v4 defaults its gradients to OKLAB (research 06 §4)

use.zh: 绕远路的色相旅行:in oklch longer hue 让红→黄走蓝紫一侧,适合 Aurora/mesh 光斑的色相编排(调研 06§14)
use.en: Deliberate long-way hue journeys: in oklch longer hue sends red→yellow around the blue side — handy for Aurora/mesh hue choreography (research 06 §14)

use.zh: P3 屏渐变增强:in display-p3 配 @media (color-gamut: p3) 覆写更鲜艳版本(调研 06§3)
use.en: P3-screen gradient enhancement: in display-p3 with @media (color-gamut: p3) overrides for extra vividness (research 06 §3)

avoid.zh: 对直角空间写 hue 策略——语法表只允许柱坐标空间(hsl/hwb/lch/oklch)携带 hue 关键词,写错整条声明无效
avoid.en: Attaching hue strategies to rectangular spaces — the grammar only lets polar spaces (hsl/hwb/lch/oklch) carry a hue keyword; a mistake invalidates the whole declaration

avoid.zh: 默认(不写 in)直接上线的长距渐变——旧式颜色在 sRGB 插值,中段发灰发脏;这是规范的兼容条款,不是 bug(调研 06§4)
avoid.en: Shipping long gradients without `in` — legacy colors interpolate in sRGB and the middle turns gray; that is the spec's compatibility clause, not a bug (research 06 §4)

avoid.zh: 同一渐变既无兜底声明又只有 in 语法——不支持的老浏览器会整条丢弃,必须有普通渐变在前
avoid.en: Shipping an in-only gradient with no fallback declaration — old browsers drop it wholesale; a plain gradient must come first

avoid.zh: 渐变上叠小字不核对对比度:按最亮/最暗两端分别查(Aurora 配方建议光斑亮度保持 0.6–0.75,既发光又不炸文字对比度,调研 06§14)
avoid.en: Small text over gradients without checking both the brightest and darkest ends (the Aurora recipe keeps blob lightness at 0.6–0.75 — glowing without wrecking text contrast, research 06 §14)

a11y.zh: 渐变本身不传达信息时无 a11y 义务;渐变上的文字要按『最亮端与最暗端』两种极端分别核对 4.5:1(正文)/3:1(大字),UI 组件边界 3:1(SC 1.4.11)——插值空间的选择会改变中段亮度,从而改变最差点位。Aurora/mesh 配方以光斑亮度 0.6–0.75 控制对比度风险(调研 06§14);渐变不得作为传达关键信息的唯一手段。
a11y.en: A decorative gradient carries no a11y duty by itself; text over one must be checked at both the brightest and darkest extremes for 4.5:1 (body) / 3:1 (large), with UI boundaries at 3:1 (SC 1.4.11) — the choice of interpolation space shifts mid-band lightness and therefore the worst point. Aurora/mesh recipes hold blob lightness at 0.6–0.75 to bound the risk (research 06 §14); never let a gradient be the sole carrier of key information.

goal.zh: 实现同一对端色在不同插值空间下的渐变对比:主条带用 in 空间(+柱坐标空间选 hue 策略)语法,并排展示 sRGB/oklab/oklch/display-p3 四条与各自 50% 中点色,提供无 in 兜底。
goal.en: Implement a same-endpoints comparison of gradients across interpolation spaces: a main strip using the in-space syntax (+ hue strategy on polar spaces), side-by-side sRGB/oklab/oklch/display-p3 rows with their 50% midpoints, and a no-in fallback.

acceptance.zh: 渐变以 in <space> [hue 策略] 显式声明,hue 策略只施加给柱坐标空间(oklch)
acceptance.en: Gradients declare in <space> [hue strategy] explicitly; hue strategies apply only to polar spaces (oklch)

acceptance.zh: 四个空间并排对比,当前选中项高亮,参数改动即时重绘
acceptance.en: The four spaces render side by side with the selected one highlighted, redrawing live on param changes

acceptance.zh: 各空间 50% 中点用 color-mix(in 空间, from, to) 展示,sRGB 的脏灰中点一目了然
acceptance.en: Each space's 50% midpoint shows via color-mix(in space, from, to), exposing sRGB's muddy midband

acceptance.zh: 无 in 的普通渐变兜底声明在前,内联 in 渐变仅在其可解析时生效
acceptance.en: A plain no-in gradient fallback comes first; the inline in-gradient applies only when parseable

acceptance.zh: 默认端色取调研/spec 例证 red(#FF0000)→blue(#0000FF)
acceptance.en: Default endpoints follow the research/spec example red (#FF0000) → blue (#0000FF)
